summary: A playable browser RTS slice: two asymmetric factions, worker economy, base building, tech, fog of war, three AI levels, tutorial, verified replays and post-game stats on one procedurally built map, running on a deterministic 20 Hz simulation.
notes: All art and audio are generated by code. No human played a full match: the opening, surrender, post-game and replay were driven with real input in headless Edge; mid-game screenshots use an AI autopilot debug hook (window.__sf) on the production build. Real-GPU frame rate and audio output are unverified. WASD pans only while nothing is selected (arrows always pan); Alt+number also assigns control groups.
